entries: This piece of ammunition has a refined delerium arrowtip. A creature hit by a ranged attack using one of these arrows takes an extra ({@dice 3d6}) necrotic damage and must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or gain one {@adventure level of contamination|DoDk|12}. Once it hits a target, the delerium tip crumbles to dust and the arrow becomes nonmagical.
